description: Side-by-side comparison of two to four electric vehicles: range (each with its test cycle), charging, battery, price and the other specs, the leading value marked per row, a short verdict, the version each column stands for, sources and cover photo credits. Each model is compared on its named version, and every figure says which version it belongs to. Use it for 'X vs Y' and 'which should I buy' questions; get slugs from search_models first. Returns Markdown with the canonical comparison URL, plus the figures as structured fields.

slug_a.description: Shorter two-model form: first model slug (use with slug_b instead of slugs).

slugs.description: Two to four model slugs, e.g. ['tesla-model-3', 'hyundai-ioniq-6'].

name: compare_models

cycle.description: Test cycle of a range figure (wltp, epa, cltc, nedc).

observed_at.description: Date the source was read, YYYY-MM-DD.

source.description: Page the figure was read from.

value.description: The figure as shown; units are in the field name (km, kwh, kw, min, s, kg...).

terms.description: Terms the data is given under.

title: Compare EVs side by side
